title: engine: parallel branch crashes must be captured as error steps
description: Investigation found f60bf5a wraps current-node execution and transition selection, but parallel=true branch execution in runner/engine.py still calls _run_single_node(target, _clone_context(ctx), graph) outside an exception boundary. A branch handler crash can still escape run(), skip CXDB/error StepRecord persistence, and leave only finally cleanup. Acceptance: add a regression test where a parallel branch handler raises; run() must return without raising, record an error step for the branch target or parent fanout with exception metadata, write the per-run log traceback, and compute the join/final outcome conservatively as error/failure.
notes: Merged in PR #13 as a46ad8288cca16b244f558807bd9cec74e562aeb. Parallel branch crashes now record error steps and final run outcome is error; clean PR-head full suite passed 106 tests.

title: engine: auto per-run resumability — persist checkpoint + launch manifest (pipeline path, --state, backend, workdir) per run so a crashed run resumes via 'df resume <run_id>' without reconstructing the command
handlers: real-LLM/codergen node timeout — _tool default 300s is too low; raise default or refuse to run a validation=true node without an explicit adequate timeout (crash#1 root)
cli: top-level panic hook writes crash artifact and exits distinctly
description: Architectural gap from factory improvement review: f60bf5a records many run-loop node/transition exceptions, but top-level CLI failures before/after run() can still bypass CXDB/log capture: parse/preflight errors, evidence-bundle write failures, summary serialization, or other unexpected exceptions in runner/__main__.py. Acceptance: install a narrow top-level exception boundary for the CLI that writes a crash JSON/log artifact keyed by run_id when available, records CXDB runs.final='error' when possible, prints artifact paths, and exits with a distinctive non-generic code (proposal: 128). Must preserve normal argparse/user-error behavior and include tests for parse-time and post-run bundle failure paths.

title: handlers: backend timeouts should return structured Result metadata
description: Timeout handling is inconsistent: claude/claudew/agy catch TimeoutExpired and return failure, while codex, tool, slash gates, and some subprocess calls can raise TimeoutExpired into the engine-level exception path. That loses backend-specific stdout/stderr context and classifies expected node timeouts as generic engine errors. Acceptance: all subprocess-backed handlers convert TimeoutExpired to Result(outcome='failure' or 'error' by documented taxonomy) with timeout_s, backend/command, partial stdout/stderr when available, timed_out=true metadata, and regression tests for codex/tool/slash gate timeout behavior.

title: observability: structured runner JSONL events with transcript sidecars
description: Architectural gap from factory improvement review: current per-run logs are human text and CXDB stores truncated output_head, so diagnostic context can still be lost or hard to correlate. Acceptance: create a per-run structured JSONL event stream under ~/.dark-factory/runs/<run_id>/events.jsonl with event types for run_start, node_start, node_result, retry, transition, checkpoint, persistence_error, run_end, and crash. Full backend stdout/stderr/LLM transcripts must be sidecar files indexed by run_id/seq/node with hashes and paths in JSONL, not embedded wholesale in the primary stream. Holdout outputs remain redacted per existing evidence-bundle policy.

title: engine: merge crash-resilience — run() try/except around node exec + transition, error StepRecord, route-to-fix, runs.final=error, per-run logs (f60bf5a/feat/runner-crash-resilience)
notes: Merged in PR #13 as a46ad8288cca16b244f558807bd9cec74e562aeb. Verified clean PR head 6c04a168a8ec1823d49959835e00caa35cbc74a6 with tests/test_crash_resilience.py tests/test_engine.py -> 17 passed and full tests/ -> 106 passed.

title: engine: persistence failures must not kill the primary run
description: _append_record writes checkpoints and CXDB rows inline. If checkpoint.write_text(), cxdb.record_step(), or cxdb.end_run() raises (bad path, disk full, locked db beyond timeout), the orchestrator can still crash while trying to record a failure. Acceptance: isolate persistence errors behind a narrow boundary, log them to the per-run log, expose persistence_error metadata/state, continue or end with an explicit infrastructure error, and add tests for checkpoint write failure and CXDB record_step failure.

title: Implement Factory Architectural Roadmap (docs/plans/factory_improvement_analysis.md)
description: Track the complete implementation of the 5-pillar architectural roadmap outlined in docs/plans/factory_improvement_analysis.md: 1) Global Panic Hook, 2) JSONL logging, 3) Pre-flight validation, 4) Dynamic timeouts, 5) WAL checkpoint resumability.

title: pipelines: ship brownfield delete-first .dot templates + reusable net-LOC<=0 and dead-code gate node handlers so brownfield refactors aren't hand-rolled (greenfield-shape misuse caused the +2507/-54 dead-code run)
runner: heartbeat current-node start/progress artifact for hung runs
description: Per-run logging captures completed steps and caught exceptions, but a hard hang or external kill during a long node can still leave ambiguity about the active node, command, timeout, and elapsed time. Acceptance: before each node starts, write/update a durable heartbeat/manifest under ~/.dark-factory/runs/<run_id>/ with pipeline, goal, workdir, current node, start timestamp, backend, timeout, and last completed seq; update on completion; tests verify heartbeat survives a simulated handler hang/kill boundary at least up to node-start state.

title: spawn: integrate file-domain locking (merge_train) at run start so a factory run reserves its target worktree files and cannot collide with a parallel agent on the same branch
monitor: declare DONE only when exit node recorded (never runs.final); CXDB run isolation — pin all queries by run_id or use per-run db to stop cross-run contamination
cli: 'df validate <pipeline.dot>' pre-flight — absolute prompt paths exist, every validation=true/codergen node has timeout>=threshold, all edges resolve to nodes; fail-fast before launch
reviewer gates: file-backed current-head diff/evidence audit for brownfield PRs
description: General reviewer-node contract gap found via PR #7178 history: factory reviewer gates must fail closed for any target repository when a brownfield DELETE/refactor/replacement task becomes greenfield additive work, stale proof, or dead code. Acceptance: add a repo-agnostic reviewer/gate node contract that writes a file-backed verdict artifact; records target_repo, target_pr, target_head_sha, base_sha, diff summary, PR description snapshot, evidence artifact paths, and evidence SHA; audits PR description vs current HEAD diff vs evidence; requires deletion/executor/dead-code/net-LOC checks when the task is replacement/delete work; and fails closed on missing artifact, stale evidence, unresolved required review state, or WARN/INCONCLUSIVE for required deletion proof. PR #7178 is evidence for the failure mode, not a special-case target.

title: backend: pre-run health check — verify the selected backend CLI (claude/codex/agy) is authenticated and responsive before a long run; fail-fast with a clear message instead of crashing mid-run
cli: always print run_id and artifact paths in failure summaries
description: The crash-resilience fix creates per-run logs, but the CLI summary currently omits ctx.run_id, ~/.dark-factory/logs/<run_id>.log, checkpoint path, CXDB path, and evidence-bundle path. Operators should not have to infer where the diagnosis artifact landed after a failed long run. Acceptance: JSON summary includes run_id, log_path, cxdb_path, checkpoint_path, evidence_bundle path when present, and final_outcome; tests assert a failing run prints these fields.
